one_liner: API (SP-API) for sellers, vendors, and third-party developers to manage Amazon marketplace listings, orders, and operations.

auth.notes: Authorization uses Login with Amazon (LWA), an OAuth2 implementation, to get refresh/access tokens per selling partner; requests are additionally signed (SigV4-style/AWS IAM) for restricted operations.

access.notes: Developers self-register once, but private and especially public SP-API applications must be registered and approved before they can be authorized by third-party sellers; access to restricted data/PII requires additional Amazon approval.

api.notes: SP-API spans many domains (orders, listings, fulfillment, finance, reports); broad by endpoint count.

verdict.rationale: OAuth-based API exists but a developer application must be registered and approved by Amazon before it can act on other sellers' accounts in production.
